reviews.comment: really good professor, probably the best biochem prof you can get if you want to keep a good gpa. doesn't want to see you or anyone fail the class, even mentioned that first day. just read the slides and pay attention, you will do well in this class. also good grade cutoffs

Really nice professor, well structured class, and he kinda comes off as nonchalant but in a very funny way. He cracks jokes here and there and makes exams really similar to the slides and his reviews were great. If you can, get BICH with this guy because the difference between him and some of the other profs is insane.

This guy is unintentionally funny. Very caring and you can tell he actually cares but in a nonchalant way yk. Made a typically difficult class feel very understandable and easy to follow along, and he actually took our advice and tried to make things easier on us. It's rare to find a guy who genuinely wants to see everyone do well at this level.

Professor Xuewu is very knowledgeable throughout lectures and very generous when grading. He offered extra credit based on attendance, feedback, and course evals. His exams are very doable and everything discussed in lecture is tested. He posts past exams but no answer keys to study. He's a bit sarcastic/rude if on your phone or answer wrong
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Sui was a solid professor; I wish the class had more assignments. There are 3 quizzes, each worth 10% of your grade, 2 homework assignments, and a group project that is worth 45% of your overall grade. Prepare to answer questions in your presentation; he asks challenging ones. I really appreciated the extra credit he gave.
